items.title: 25.4.1 Rapid Growth of Human Populations (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 25.4.1 and its three boxes, printed page 238.

blocks.text: 1700s ke shuru se technology mein aane wali tabdeeliyon ne insanon ko apni khuraak ki faraahmi par zyada ikhtiyar diya, shikari janwaron (predators) se bachne ke liye behtar hathiyar banane ke qabil banaya, aur bohat si bimariyon ke ilaaj (remedies) daryaft hue. Saath hi insan mausam ki be-yaqeeni (climatic uncertainties) ke saamne kam kamzor ho gaye. In tabdeeliyon ki wajah se insan apne rehne ki jaghon ki carrying capacity barha sake.

Duniya ki taqreeban 16% (1.28 billion) aabadi taraqqi yafta (developed) mulkon mein rehti hai, jabke baqi 84% (6.72 billion) taraqqi pazeer (developing) mulkon mein. Pakistan Bureau of Statistics ke mutabiq 2023 ki aakhri mardum shumari (census) mein Pakistan ki aabadi 241.49 million thi. Pakistan ki aabadi barhne ki sarkari sharah (growth rate) 2.55% salana hai.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: UNO (Aqwam-e-Muttahida) ke mutabiq Pakistan ki aabadi ab 250 million se barh chuki hai. Pakistan duniya ka 5wan sab se zyada aabadi wala mulk hai.
Tezi se barhti insani aabadi shayad biosphere ke mustaqbil ke liye sab se bara challenge hai. Yeh duniya ke mahol par bohat zyada boojh daal rahi hai. In mein se kuch asraat yeh hain:

items: Habitat (jandaron ke rehne ki jaghon) ki tabahi aur zameen ke istemal mein tabdeeli
Qudrati wasail (meetha paani, fossil fuels waghaira) ka khatam hona
Jangalat ki katai (deforestation) aur biodiversity (jandaron ki qismon) ka nuqsan
Nayi wabaon (epidemics) aur aalami wabaon (pandemics), bhook (starvation) aur ghizai kami (malnutrition) ke barhte imkanaat

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Agar zameen ki tamam zindagi ko tola jaye to insani aabadi zameen ke kul biomass (jandaron ke wazan) ka sirf taqreeban 0.01% hai. Zameen ka taqreeban 82% biomass paudon ka aur taqreeban 13% bacteria ka hai.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Duniya ki sab se ameer 20% aabadi duniya ke 86% wasail istemal karti hai aur duniya ki 53% carbon dioxide emissions paida karti hai. Jabke sab se ghareeb 20% aabadi sirf 1.3% wasail istemal karti hai aur sirf 3% CO₂ kharij karti hai.

blocks.prompt: Insanon ne apne rehne ki jaghon ki carrying capacity kaise barhayi?
blocks.explanation: Technology ke zariye: khuraak ki faraahmi par zyada ikhtiyar, predators se bachne ke behtar hathiyar, bimariyon ke ilaaj, aur mausam ki be-yaqeeni se kam mutasir hona.

items: 1700s se technology ne insanon ki carrying capacity barhayi.
Duniya: 16% developed, 84% developing mulkon mein; Pakistan 241.49 million (2023 census), growth rate 2.55% salana.
Asraat: habitat ki tabahi, wasail ki kami, ghurbat, aaloodgi, climate change, biodiversity ka nuqsan, wabaein aur bhook.
